_meta.description: Complete structural graph of Christopher Alexander's A Pattern Language (Oxford University Press, 1977) -- all 253 patterns, real cross-references only (pattern numbers and names). No copyrighted Problem/Solution prose is reproduced here.
_meta.source: https://patternlanguage.cc/static/contentIndex.json -- Quartz 4's own precomputed content-link index for the deployed site (a mirror of https://github.com/zenodotus280/apl-md). Downloaded directly via curl and parsed programmatically -- not read or summarized by a model -- so there is no hallucination or per-page-summary-variance risk anywhere in this file.
_meta.fields: 'cites' = the real, complete set of other patterns this pattern's own page content links to (drawn from its 'Related Patterns' prose, where Alexander names both broader patterns this one helps complete and narrower patterns it calls for, mixed in running text with no clean structural marker between the two). 'cited_by' = the exact inverse: every pattern whose own page links here. Together these form a complete, symmetric, real citation graph.
_meta.not_the_same_as: This deliberately does NOT attempt to split 'cites' into Alexander's own 'larger patterns' (broader context) vs 'smaller patterns' (detail patterns called for) -- his prose mixes both in one paragraph with no reliable structural cue to separate them by parsing alone; that split requires reading each pattern's own prose, which street-smarts-patterns::cascade_contracts.rs's existing 15-pattern-generator citations (and a small number of others) do individually where the distinction matters for a specific contract's 'why'. This file's job is completeness and connectivity, not that finer semantic split.
_meta.history: This file started as a 15-pattern subgraph (this project's own implemented generators), built by fetching individual rendered patternlanguage.cc pages one at a time and having each summarized. Four of those fifteen (29, 95, 96, 108) were briefly written in from unverified recall rather than a real fetch after their pages failed to load -- a real citation-discipline lapse, caught and fixed the same day (see git history: 'Fix apl-pattern-graph.json: 4 patterns were recalled, not fetched'). This version replaces that whole approach: instead of per-page model summaries, it's built by downloading patternlanguage.cc's own precomputed Quartz content-link index (static/contentIndex.json) as raw JSON and parsing it programmatically, covering all 253 patterns with no model interpretation and no hallucination surface at all.
_meta.cascade_contracts_note: street-smarts-patterns::cascade_contracts.rs's own 'why' citations were written against the original 15-pattern subgraph's real larger/smaller reads and remain accurate -- every specific fact they cite (e.g. '95's smaller-patterns list includes 99') still holds in this file's 'cites'/'cited_by' fields, just under renamed, honestly-scoped field names (see 'not_the_same_as' above).
